final_resume.summary: Software Engineer II candidate with 2 years of hands-on experience in embedded systems and test automation, proficient in Python and C++. Seeking to transition into full-stack development with a focus on distributed systems and system design, leveraging strong debugging and code review practices.

bullets: Tested BLE pairing and GATT services across 12 Android and iOS devices, ensuring firmware stability for wearable product line.
Automated 150 firmware regression test cases using Python and pytest, reducing regression cycle time from 3 days to 1 day.
Triaged and logged defects in JIRA with firmware developers during 2-week sprints, improving issue resolution velocity.

projects.name: ESP32 BLE Sensor Logger
projects.description: Developed C firmware on ESP32 with FreeRTOS that advertises temperature readings over BLE and logs data to flash memory. Demonstrates embedded systems design and low-level protocol implementation.

profile_improvement_tips: Gain hands-on experience with JavaScript or Java to match core backend languages in the JD; consider a small project or online course.
Build familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services—compute, storage, networking—through free tier projects or certifications.
Expand system design knowledge by studying distributed systems patterns (consensus, replication, sharding) and documenting a design review or architecture decision in your portfolio.
final_resume.growth_note: Your QA and embedded background is strong, but the JD targets full-stack and distributed systems development. You have 2 of 10 curated keywords; JavaScript, Java, and GCP are critical gaps. Consider a 3-6 month ramp to bridge these before applying, or target embedded/firmware roles at Google Cloud that better align with your current profile.
